title: list.sort() minrun computation is incorrect for very large lists on some architectures
author: neelsomani
body_preview: ### Bug report  `list.sort()`'s PowerSort implementation computes the mask used by the minrun generator as:  ```c ms->mr_mask = (1 << ms->mr_e) - 1; ```  Here, `mr_mask` and `mr_e` are `Py_ssize_t`, but the literal `1` has type `int`.
